subject: shiny server open source not end session every time?

messages.author: 9662ffcc8330ee89
messages.subject: shiny server open source not end session every time?
parts:
Hi Guy,
I am first time building website by just using R+shiny+shiny server open source in Ubuntu (desktop 12.04 LTS x64) environment.
Previously, I use a test version of shiny server software built my app.
One can refresh or close the window to end the session so that one can refresh and get back to get a whole new session.
I am currently building by using the released version of shiny server open source software.
 
The basic approach I used:
* build the basic OS (with gcc etc.)
* add a cran repository to the local sources
* install R (which will be the latest)
* install the development support for R

Then as root in R
* add ‘shiny’

Then back to LINUx to install the latest shiny-server as described on the r-studio.com site.

To provide the support for the iNZight-Shiny app, we then add the following packages to R as root
* httr
* codetools
* RCurl
* devtools
* markdown
 
I can start a website but once I close or refresh the browser the web app stop and I run  restart server in the console.
For previous shiny test version, I don't need to restart server by myself.
Can anyone tell me what I can do now to avoid every time restart server manually??
I guess I can use session$onSessionEnded(callback) to do callback after session end or I can set stopApp()..
However, I have no idea what the next step I need to do?
 
Thank you.
